_comment: FIXED parameters for the 15m MTF Confluence Lean optimizer. REVISED 2026-08-11: the S6 block (useS6/s6_len/s6_margin/s6_vis/s6_prox), the G4 block (useG4/g4_lb/g4_volLen/g4_boxW/g4_atrMult), position sizing (qty_pct_equity) and the exit-management switches (rrUsePartialTp/rrTp1Pct/rrTp2Pct/rrUseBE/rrUseTrailSl/rrTrailPct/rrTrailActPct) were MOVED OUT of this file into params.json so the GA can search them. They are deliberately absent here - one source of truth. s6_tf/g4_tf, TP1/TP2 close-% sizes (40/30) and the BE trigger/offset (1.0R/0.1R) remain fixed.  REALISM PASS 2026-08-12: fixed $1000 cash per trade (qty_pct_equity removed from the search space and pinned to 0), initialCapital raised 1000 -> 10000 so $1000/trade is a genuine 10% slice that is always affordable (at 1000 capital a $1000 order was still 100% of the account, which is what we were moving away from), commission 0.1% PER SIDE (= 0.2% round trip, matching Binance spot taker fees), slippage 0 -> 2 ticks. These match the Pine script's own strategy() declaration: initial_capital=10000, default_qty_value=1000, strategy.cash. NOTE: slippage is per-TICK so its % cost varies by symbol (RIFUSDT ~0.217% vs ZECUSDT ~0.004% for the same 2 ticks).
